q: What are the emissions from processing dried fish?
title: Dried fish processing emissions
short: Sun drying on racks uses almost no energy, so emissions come from ice, salt, transport and packing. Mechanical or solar-assisted dryers add fuel or electricity. Work per kg of dried product: fresh fish loses most of its weight, so divide energy by output, not by fish landed.

ul: Dryer fuel or electricity, if used.

p: Divide total energy emissions by kg of dried product sold. Catch emissions come from the vessel's fuel; ask suppliers or use a database figure.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices and electricity bills and applies IPCC 2006 factors and the CEA grid factor (0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25), so you can compare Scope 1 and 2 before and after a change from the documents themselves.
